result.cmd_controller_execute: {"command": "echo \"CPU usage refers to the percentage of time the CPU spends executing instructions. It can be measured per core or overall. On Windows, use Task Manager or PowerShell Get-Counter \\\\Processor(_Total)\\% Processor Time. On Linux, use top or htop; the %CPU column shows usage. On macOS, use top or Activity Monitor. For scripting, use psutil in Python: psutil.cpu_percent(interval=1).\""}
